notes:
Lead source: inbound — demo signups from public website.
Product/context: CopperStrait builds a lightweight in-app chat assistant embedded inside their B2B SaaS admin console (multi-tenant). Primary ask: streaming responses with low UI latency and predictable cost as they scale.
Quote from founder: "Users expect nearly instantaneous type-ahead / streaming replies — we lose adoption if responses feel slow. Need p95 latency under ~200ms for 1-2k concurrent users per region."
Technical remarks: preferring hosted API to avoid infra ops; interested in transparent token accounting and streaming websockets for partial updates; considering smaller open models for cost but want fallback to higher-quality variant when context gets complex. Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations for batching and cache settings.
Security/compliance: SOC2 baseline required for customer procurement checklist; they use SSO (SAML) and will want audit logs exported to their SIEM (Splunk). Data residency not strict — US first, EU later.
POC plan: 1-week streaming POC using hosted API (2 tenants, synthetic load to test tail latencies), then trial expansion to 10 tenants.
Notes on cost sensitivity: seed-stage startup but revenue-generating; very sensitive to per-token costs at scale — looking for guidance on quantized model variants and caching to reduce token churn.
Stubs/links: pricing deck (drive:/decks/copperstrait-hosted-api-pricing-v1.pdf), security FAQ (drive:/security/copperstrait-sso-soc2-qa.md), Fireflies calls ff_20260218_001 and ff_20260302_007.
AE notes: prioritize quick sandbox keys + clear streaming example repo; schedule follow-up 1:1 to walk through p95 measurement approach and fallback policies.
